name: azure-managed-identity
description:
Authenticates outbound requests to an Azure-hosted backend using a User-Assigned
Managed Identity (UMI). No client secret is configured - the gateway asks the Azure
platform's Instance Metadata Service (IMDS) for a token on the identity's behalf.
Only works when gateway-runtime runs on Azure compute (VM, App Service, or an AKS
node) with the target identity attached. Tokens are cached in Redis so every
gateway-runtime replica shares one token per API/route, with a local in-process
cache in front for near-zero hot-path latency - same caching design as the oauth2
policy.
